comparison: The owner also reports that the preceding fastener-free tesseract printed well on the A1. This makes the early one-bed failures of the newer design noteworthy, but does not establish their cause.
causality: The initial new-design P1S and A1 slices were confirmed to use Cool Plate/35 C in error. Temperature, bed cleaning, part grouping, brim width and first-layer settings changed for this retry, so the improvement does not isolate a single cause.
